## Course access

Public pages need no login. Member records are held outside the public directory.
Sign in through the gate page in the same browser. GET /gate/handshake returns connection details.
The person signs in and approves a fresh OAuth connection at https://hq.mega.dev. Use only the returned same-origin /gate/login URL.
The backend verifies enrollment through the official MCP, attempts to revoke the fresh tokens, discards them and sets its own HttpOnly cookie.
Never copy existing credentials, tokens or codes into chat. GET /gate/check returns 200 for a valid cookie, otherwise 401.
Errors never grant access. A static copy includes neither the gate service nor private records.
